title: The Authorized User
dek: Google gates its best security AI to 'defenders.' The DOJ asks who controls open model distribution. $63B in bank debt backs compute nobody governs.

stories.label: Google's score on SEC-bench Pro for vulnerability finding
stories.headline: Google gets to decide who counts as a defender.

stories.label: Nvidia's bid to own the main hub for open-source AI
stories.headline: Whoever controls the distribution layer controls what runs where.

stories.label: bank debt for Anthropic compute, no governance rights attached
stories.headline: The banks will hold the bill. They won't hold the model.

stories.label: potential cut to US humanoid robotics revenue from barriers
stories.headline: The US is sealing the chassis while subsidizing the brain.
OpenAI cannot tell if its agent followed instructions or evaded oversight.

still_signal: Every institution reaching for AI governance is grabbing a lever slightly too small for the problem. Not that no one is governing: everyone is, with incompatible definitions.
